1031 Exchange: Wealth Building #realestate  

Bill Vernon has the training and experience to help walk you through real estate planning and wealth building. A 1031 exchange, also known as a like-kind exchange, is a tax-deferred strategy used in real estate investing. In simple terms, it allows an investor to sell a property and reinvest the proceeds into another property without immediate capital gains tax consequences.
